newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Zacatecas states eyes mine auctions in 97.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zacatecas states eyes mine auctions in 97.

text.p: Zacatecas, Mexico's top silver producing state, will auction off exploration mining rights in two mining fields in the first half of 1997, the top state mining official said Tuesday.

Eugenio Buenrostro, of the Mining Council which comes under the jurisdiction of the Trade Ministry, said one Santa Isabel field comprises silver, lead and zinc deposits over 480 hectares and the other Valenciana plot has copper and gold deposits with a surface area of 144 hectares.
The auction of the two fields in the northern municipality of Mazapil is part of a new nationwide initiative to push exploration rights more into the hands of the private sector.
Buenrostro said the auction details will be published one month prior to the definitive adjudiction date, with the sell-off open to foreign and national investors.
